## Import



TEO confirm multi-path gateway origin ACL can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Teo/confirmMultiPathGatewayOriginAcl:ConfirmMultiPathGatewayOriginAcl example zone-3edjdliiw3he#gw-abc12345
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
